codeReview.summary: The feature correctly moved the five provider-local helpers to @parchi/shared and updated those imports, but it does not satisfy the feature's own expected behavior or VAL-CON-002 because duplicate asString implementations still remain elsewhere in the repository.

A second non-shared local asString implementation remains in the repository, so the feature does not achieve the expected single shared implementation required by VAL-CON-002 and the feature contract.
Another local asString implementation remains in electron-agent logic, leaving multiple duplicate implementations in the repo instead of one shared helper.
